scope: Source-derived review candidates; no application code changed and no runtime test executed.

items.finding: ProjectTrust tag has no host emitter/three-way decision path; missing/error trust defaults true, and project_only chooses project extension dirs before the trust branch.
items.review: SET-003 owns policy/store detail. Independently confirm executable admission and distinguish intended policy from implementation gap.

items.finding: invoke_renderer matches renderer kind but ignores registration name/customType; first valid JSON result can claim an unrelated custom type and suppress a later usable renderer.
items.review: Review exact-name routing, valid-but-unrenderable output and callback keepalive.

items.finding: BeforeAgentStart is constructed as a Data payload by provider hook dispatch but is grouped as payload-free by free_dispatched_event.
items.review: Confirmed control-flow mismatch; no measured leak execution. Other tags require their own constructor proof.

items.finding: dispatch_to_handlers returns on stale snapshot before reclaiming already-created host-owned event strings.
items.review: Review caller ownership on stale dispatch; do not broaden to unproven use-after-free claims.

items.finding: PluginApi free_string documentation suggests plugin ownership of event payloads, contradicting borrowed EventView semantics and host cleanup.
items.review: Align docs and producer/borrow ownership; following the wrong ownership instruction can conflict with host reclamation.

items.finding: Native shortcut routing uses bare key names for shortcut lookup and emits to all Input subscribers, instead of the TS selected shortcut owner's handler.
items.review: Confirm modifier-qualified registration behavior and ownership before calling complete shortcut parity.

items.finding: Reload callback path ignores missing/disconnected reload signal errors and returns null, so success does not prove reload was queued.
items.review: Session owner should assess channel lifecycle and failure propagation; do not rely on stale comments claiming fallback.

items.finding: Native dispatch_event trampoline returns zero without forwarding an extension event bus message.
items.review: A callback pointer being non-null is not behavioral event-bus support.

items.finding: Native resource-discovery theme paths are accepted by collector but only skill/prompt paths are consumed at startup/reload.
items.review: Session owner confirms full caller path; TUI/settings own actual theme catalog wiring.

items.finding: TypeScript input dialog accepts a placeholder parameter but its interactive component ignores _placeholder.
items.review: Source/documentation divergence; native input does implement a placeholder.

items.finding: A custom asynchronous component factory can resolve after done settled and leave a late component outside the normal disposal path.
items.review: Potential resource-retention case from source order; needs a dedicated implementation review, not assumed reproduced.
